name: Flaky tests
description: Runs the tests several times and shows each test's pass rate; the ones that pass only sometimes are flaky, and an agent can fix one.

commands.name: run
commands.description: Run the test command the set number of times and answer with the flaky and always-failing tests. Waits up to 25 seconds; longer runs go on in the tile, then ask with flaky.

commands.name: flaky
commands.description: The last runs' flaky tests (passed sometimes, failed sometimes), with how often each passed and failed, and the tests that always failed.

settings.label: Test command
settings.description: Run in the repository without a shell: a program and its arguments, "quoted" words kept whole.

settings.label: Runs
settings.description: How many times to run it, one after another.

tools.label: Flaky tests
tools.description: Each test's pass rate over several runs.
